items.text: Titles such as business associate, business executive and business development executive are used loosely, so the same title can mean sales, operations or support, and the only reliable way to know is to read the duties, ask about targets and look at what the previous holders moved on to.
Ask who you report to, how success is measured and where people in the role go next.
Ask for written details before accepting.
